title: AI Agent runtimes
body: OpenClaw / Hermes / IonClaw install and supervision; all tool calls go through Allowlist and approval.
expBody: Registration ≠ online. Real ops use CLI:
fleetCanDesc: Not a hollow list — real control-plane capabilities for edge nodes
capRegisterD: Writes control-plane list (status “registered only”) — process may not be running
capCommandD: CLI presets (readiness / host / projects…) or custom; edge pulls, runs ysk-server, and acks
capHistoryD: queued / done / error, exit code, pretty JSON result
capStatusD: Registered only → online (heartbeat) → stale (>60s without heartbeat)
emptyAgentsDesc: Register from the list, or wait for edge processes to self-register
emptyCmdsDesc: Queue with “Command”; stays queued until the edge agent is online
edgeOnlineDesc: After panel registration, the node must run the outbound loop to heartbeat / pull commands
controlPlaneHint: (must be reachable; use the real panel address in production)
queueNote: Without an edge process, “Command” still works: it queues until the agent comes online.
emptyRuntimeDesc: Refresh to load runtimes, or probe individually
registerDesc: Writes control-plane list only; does not mean the node is online
agentIdHint: Unique ID, e.g. edge-1 or office-gateway
registerNote: Status shows “registered only” until the node runs the outbound agent and heartbeats.
cmdDesc: Queued; edge agent pulls, runs, and acks (stays queued while offline)
cliArgsHint: Do not include ysk-server; e.g. logs journal --unit nginx.service
cmdNote: Edge ysk-server agent run executes CLI JSON locally (adds --json). Host changes still need YSK_EXECUTE=1 on the edge. See exit code and JSON in History.
